phrases.latin: Rīvus, quī vēre strepit, siccus erat
phrases.english: The stream, which babbles in spring, was dry

phrases.latin: «Ubi est aqua, tata?» «Dēfēcit; aestāte enim exeunte parum pluit.»
phrases.english: “Where’s the water, Dad?” “It has run out; at the end of summer it hardly rained.”

sources: Lewis & Short: rivus
